verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a send-later (scheduled send) feature or an undo-send grace window in Missive. The closest items are adjacent: snoozing defers incoming conversations, and multi-step rules add delays to automations. Neither is a scheduled outbound send or a send-cancellation window, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
